script_text: Stop, Pisces — the planets are testing who deserves access to your heart. In a Pisces whole-sign framework, the Taurus Moon conjuncts Uranus in your 3rd House and opposes Pluto in your 9th, while Venus in Libra squares your 1st House from the 8th. Neptune, modern ruler of your Water sign, occupies your 2nd House, where instinct and desire blur value. In love, Venus can magnetize an all-or-nothing connection tied to intimacy or shared money; single Pisces should notice possessiveness early, while partnered Pisces must state their needs clearly without testing. The 3rd House Moon-Uranus contact favors a follow-up email, teaching lead, or contract that may suddenly change direction. Venus’s 8th House square and 2nd House Neptune warn against impulsive spending or lending based on chemistry. A 9th House introduction can unexpectedly become a career contact. Follow for tomorrow’s Pisces reading.
